details.name: Receiving Input Integers Until a Certain Condition is Met (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that receives an integer from the user, outputs that integer, and stops receiving integers when the user enters a negative integer.

details.name: Receiving Input Integers Until a Certain Condition is Met (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that receives an integer from the user, outputs that integer, and stops receiving integers when the user enters an integer that is not in the range of 30 to 90 both inclusive.

details.name: Receiving Input Integers Until a Certain Condition is Met (Case 3)
details.description: Construct a program that receives an integer from the user, outputs that integer, and stops receiving integers when the user enters a negative integer or an integer greater than 1000.

details.name: Receiving Input Integers Until a Certain Condition is Met (Case 4)
details.description: Construct a program that receives an integer from the user, outputs that integer, and stops receiving integers when the user enters an even integer less than 10.
